[SWS_EM_02310] State transition - process termination after start-up timeout reaction
⌈
In case a process start-up timeout occurred after Execution
Management attemted to restart the process numberOfRestartAttempts times,
Execution Management shall request the Operating System to terminate the
underlying process.
⌋
